description: Base rubric for the 国漫暗黑 style. close_up.json / wide.json extend this; the judge reads the most specific file and falls back here.

axes.label: 角色/场景一致性 (vs bible)
checks: 固定特征词 present and unchanged (hair, eye color, scar, garment main color)
no 禁止变化项 violated relative to the locked reference image(s)

axes.label: 符合 intent / action / 景别
checks: subject, action and camera 景别 match the prompt
the stated dialogue/emotion is readable on screen (show-don't-tell)

axes.label: 解剖 / 手部 / 面部完整
checks: no extra fingers, deformed hands, melted faces, broken limbs

axes.label: 无生成伪影 / 水印 / 文字乱码
checks: no watermark, no garbled text, no lowres/blur from upscale seams

axes.label: 风格底线 (negative-floor)
checks: honors the style negative_floor (no western-cartoon look, no flat lighting)

axes.label: 镜头兑现叙事承诺 (delivery_promise)
checks: the shot delivers the dramatic beat its intent promises, not a generic pose
final_review: would a human director accept this take as-is

禁止变化项_hook: compare the generated artifact against ref_role_map images; any 禁止变化项 change => failure_mode=drift, drift=true
